profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
1. Summary
•	Embedded linux software developer in the field of Baseboard Management Controller, Android auto, gaming platforms, and set top box.
•	Development experiences of all levels of software stack, from hardware bring-up, bootloader, device driver, Middleware and Graphical User Interface (GUI) in Automotive Grade Linux, Android kernel, Gentoo kernel, embedded linux, MicroC OS, OS20 & 21.
•	Rich experience in BSP integration, device driver porting, development, and troubleshooting.
•	Metadata (recipe and patch) development of Yocto project.
•	Knowledge of multithreading programming, real time operating system (RTOS), gaming platform, digital broadcasting, TCP/IP networking protocols and wired/wireless communication.


2. Top Skills
•	Linux kernel, real time operating system, device driver and device tree development, BSP integration, multi-thread programming, firmware development, MPEG, H.264, digital broadcasting, cryptography.
•	OpenBMC software development such as MRT, RAS, IPMI, PECI, MCTP, CXL, D-bus, redfish, NVMe, etc, etc.
•	DRM Bridge, DSI/DP serializer such as TI FPD Link and Maxim GMSL and deserializer and HDMI/HDCP.
•	Communication protocols and interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, Ethernet, Modbus, Profibus and parallel bus protocols like PCI.
•	Software development for various CPU cores such as ARM, x86/64, MIPS, and ST20.
•	C, C++, Bash, Python, Perl.
•	Gnu toolchains, Git, Subversion (SVN), Perforce, Jira, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GDB, JTAG debugger, Valgrind.
•	Experience using equipment such as oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, and logic analyzer.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Development of Component Command Interface over MCTP for Compute Express Link. 
•	Developed OpenBMC recipes such as CXL, RAS manager and memory error collector for OpenBMC project.
•	Development of recipes of NIC, MRT, CPLD, MSCC raid, ACD, ASD for AMI Yocto project.
•	Integration of Intel Memory Resilience Technology (MRT) solutions.
•	Development of reverse address translation feature for DRAM page offline by OS.
•	Development of IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) tasks to communicate with BIOS and Server OS.
•	Development of PECI functions to read and to write the host CPU registers.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded C · Operating Systems · Embedded Systems · C++ programming · Firmware · Microcontrollers · C programming · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Embedded Software Development · Linux · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Development of the programmable logic controller software for machines such as gravimetric batch, continuous blender, and extruder.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded C · Operating Systems · Embedded Systems · Firmware · Microcontrollers · C programming · RTOS · Embedded Software Development

positions.title: Embedded BSP Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Bring-up DSI and DP display devices of Qualcomm Snapdragon and Samsung Exynos Auto in Android Auto, and bare metal linux.
•	Development of DRM bridge device drivers from scratch for TI FPD Link and Maxim GMSL DRM Bridge IC.
•	Development of LVDS-HDMI conversion device driver for 8-bit MCU using Microchip MPLAB X IDE.
•	Fixed video flickering issue on DSI serializer of Android Auto product.
•	Development of device tree files (dts and dtsi) for multiple DRM bridge ICs.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded C · Operating Systems · Embedded Systems · C++ programming · Firmware · Microcontrollers · C programming · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · RTOS · Embedded Software Development · Linux · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Converted 32-bit game platform application to 64-bit application.
-	Modification of makefile to build libraries and applications for both 32-bit and 64-bit targets.
-	Modification of C++ hardware abstraction layer codes to be compatible in both 32 bit and 64-bit.   
-	Fixed issues caused by 64-bit incompatible codes.
•	Development of new Gentoo linux target media and linux startup scripts.
•	Development of PCI kernel module library for SRAM device.
•	Development of udev script to provide persistent device names for multiple ethernet devices.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded C · Operating Systems · Embedded Systems · C++ programming · Firmware · Microcontrollers · C programming · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · RTOS · Embedded Software Development · Linux · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Development at all software levels of the set top box: initial hardware bring-up, bootloader and linux kernel customization, device driver porting, Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) development, middleware and application development and final application image build.
•	Development of middleware and smart card device driver to pass the security certifications consisting of unitary test and integration test which validate software and hardware implementation. The application software is finally tested with live feed signals.
•	Development of IP application that sends STB data to Splunk server running on Amazon Web Services (AWS). The data file is in JSON format and encrypted by OpenSSL and transmitted by libcurl.
•	HD zapper development using MicroC OS, which consumes less memory space than Embedded Linux. Developed OS wrapper API and integrated BSP into Nagra application software. This model became the most selling model out of Nagra-produced STB at that time.
•	Ported and debugged peripheral device drivers such as Ethernet, Wi-Fi, UART, I2C, I2S, SPI, USB and RF tuner devices.
•	Porting CloudTV SDK and developing hardware abstraction layer in C++. CloudTV allows set top box to connect to external server that provides Graphical User Interface, Electronic Program Guide and Video on Demand.
•	Scripts development for automatic application build and test automation in Python, bash and perl languages.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
• Bring-up of set top boxes and integration of BSP into middleware software.
• Hardware abstraction layer code development for real time operating systems such as embedded linux, OS20 an OS21
• Developed GPS LNB API and ported 2-way DiSEqC device driver.
• Developed device drivers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
As project manager,
• Developed Twin Tuner DVB-S PVR Set-Top Box.
• Developed Single DVB-S Tuner PVR STB for German Broadcaster Premiere.
• Developed Premiere DVB-S Zapping STB.
• Developed DVB-S/C/T tuner solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded C · Embedded Systems · Firmware · Microcontrollers · C programming · RTOS · Embedded Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• As a manager of Frontend Team, my team developed two-way cable modem solutions composed of in-band tuner, out-of-band DOCSIS cable modem.
• I led development of all RF tuner solutions. My team designed schematic of RF tuner and optimized device driver for best performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded C · Embedded Systems · Firmware · Microcontrollers · C programming · RTOS · Embedded Software Development
